warnings: WARN_SCOPED_STORAGE_OBB: Application requests external storage permissions, declares legacy storage request, or accesses external storage/OBB paths on Android 11+ (API 30+). Android 11 enforces Scoped Storage and strictly restricts raw filesystem access to Android/data and Android/obb even with legacy storage flags. Remediation: Adopt Storage Access Framework (SAF) / MediaStore API, access app-specific files via context.getExternalFilesDirs() / context.getObbDirs(), or deliver OBB files via standard app expansion / Play Asset Delivery.

WARN_DEPRECATED_PERMISSIONS: Deprecated or restricted permissions detected: ['android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE']. Remediation: android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE: Use MediaStore API or Storage Access Framework (SAF).
